structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation

law.text:
After the administrative costs for collecting the fees are recovered by the Department of Taxation, the remaining revenues shall be divided as follows:
Fifty percent shall be deposited into the state's general fund; and
Fifty percent shall be deposited into the Governor's Motion Picture Opportunity Fund established under § 2.2-2320. All revenues deposited to the Fund shall be used for film incentive programs established by the Virginia Film Office.
